evidence_excerpts: Following Correia (2006, pp. 764-5) we account for objectual essence in terms of generic essence: FULL-OBJECTUAL-ESSENCE Being F is what x is in full iff: being F is what it is to be identical to x in full.
text: Objectual essence can be accounted for through generic essence, so a feature is what an object is in full or in part according to whether it is what being identical to that object is in full or in part.
